verdict.summary: The round-2 diff remains correct and complete for the queue-normalization failure mode. Every malformed present container or row is still tolerated and dropped, but now emits a reason-specific diagnostic; valid rows remain unchanged and silent. The only input value echoed is a class string passed through the existing printable, 16-character-bounded sanitizer, while other diagnostics expose only fixed field text and safe built-in type names from the JSON-shaped input. The tests use independent literal expectations and non-vacuously cover the integer-class regression, malformed/null/missing inputs, valid silence, continued publication after total queue loss, reason specificity, and newline/oversize log-injection cases. No trust check is weakened, no reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff, and no new issue is supported relative to the prior approved round.
